key_notes: Key 1 (t=9.35s): Initial archival pose of frog; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=10.47s): Mid-sequence articulation of frog; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=11.71s): Peak dynamic extension of frog over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=12.95s): Follow-through and settle of frog with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of frog (9.35s..12.95s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
